AI.result: 治疗6个月后，血钾变化分别为：MRA组从4.12升至4.27 mmol/L（p=0.004），钾补充剂组从3.99升至4.24 mmol/L（p<0.001），联合治疗组从3.98升至4.34 mmol/L（p<0.001）。主要终点发生率分别为：对照组29%（n=175）、MRA组22%（n=16）、钾补充剂组21%（n=31）、联合治疗组22%（n=72），各组间比较p=0.8。低钾血症发生率分别为：对照组13%，MRA组3%、钾补充剂组9%、联合治疗组5%；高钾血症发生率分别为：对照组0.2%，MRA组0%、钾补充剂组3%、联合治疗组4%（组间比较p>0.1）。各方案组的具体样本量、效应量的95%置信区间及死亡事件数摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: MRA、钾补充剂或二者联合均可有效提升血浆钾水平；与对照组相比，各方案的复合终点事件率在数值上均更低，但三种方案之间在疗效和安全性上均无统计学差异，提示关键在于血钾达标，而不在于选择哪种升钾药物；联合治疗组的高钾血症发生率在数值上略高（4%），需加强监测。该分析为观察性、按实际用药非随机分组，各组样本量小且检验效能有限，结果需前瞻性随机对照研究验证。

title: The prevalence of Brugada syndrome in patients presenting to an emergency room in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Brugada syndrome (BrS) is a rare inherited arrhythmia associated with an increased risk of sudden cardiac death. Significant variation in the prevalence of BrS across different countries has been well documented. However, no study has examined the prevalence of BrS in Saudi Arabia. Therefore, our aim was to assess the prevalence of BrS in patients presenting to an emergency department (ED) in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

METHODS: This retrospective study included consecutive adult patients who presented to the ED at King Khalid University Hospital (KKUH) and underwent an electrocardiogram (ECG). Demographic and clinical variables were collected from the records, and ECGs were examined for the presence of a Brugada pattern (BrP). BrS was diagnosed when a type 1 BrP was observed with no secondary causes, and BrP was diagnosed when a non-type 1 pattern was observed. A prespecified sensitivity analysis was conducted, excluding patients whose presentation was potentially compatible with BrS (syncope, presyncope, cardiac arrest, and palpitations).

RESULTS: We included 1,000 patients. Men constituted 498 patients (49.8%). The majority were Saudi nationals (830, 85.6%) and the overall median age was 46 years (IQR: 30-65 years). The majority of the patients were afebrile at presentation (915, 93%) and a small number of patients took Brugada-inducing medications (27, 2.7%). The prevalence of BrS was 2/1,000 (0.002; 95% CI: 0.0002-0.007) and the prevalence of BrP was 26/1,000 (0.026; 95% CI: 0.0179-0.0390). Among the patients with BrP, 11 exhibited a type 2 pattern (42.3%) and 15 exhibited a type 3 pattern (57.7%). The sensitivity analysis revealed a prevalence of BrS of 2/912 (0.002; 95% CI: 0.0-0.0061) and a prevalence of BrP of 26/912 (0.028; 95% CI: 0.0178-0.0402).

CONCLUSION: This is the first Saudi Arabian study on BrS prevalence, suggesting a high prevalence and a notable proportion of non-type 1 Brugada electrocardiogram (ECG) patterns.

AI.tldr: 沙特利雅得单中心 1000 例急诊心电图回顾分析显示，Brugada 综合征患病率为 0.2%（2/1000），Brugada 图形为 2.6%，且以非 1 型图形为主。
AI.motivation: Brugada 综合征（BrS）是罕见的遗传性心律失常，与室颤及心源性猝死风险升高相关，其患病率在不同国家间差异显著。既往阿拉伯半岛地区缺乏 BrS 流行病学数据，沙特阿拉伯尚无相关研究，本研究旨在填补该地区急诊人群 BrS 患病率的证据空白。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性研究，连续纳入沙特阿拉伯利雅得 King Khalid University Hospital 急诊科就诊并完成心电图的成年患者 1000 例。从病历采集人口学与临床变量，逐份心电图判读 Brugada 图形（BrP）：出现 1 型图形且排除继发原因者诊断为 BrS；出现非 1 型图形者诊断 BrP。另行预设的敏感性分析，排除就诊表现可能与 BrS 相关者（晕厥、先兆晕厥、心脏骤停、心悸），剩余 912 例。摘要未报告具体统计方法细节。
AI.conclusion: 这是沙特阿拉伯首个 BrS 患病率研究，提示当地急诊人群 BrS 患病率相对较高，且非 1 型 Brugada 心电图图形占相当比例，提示临床判读心电图时需警惕并将此类患者纳入随访评估。局限性包括单中心回顾性设计、以单次静息心电图判读为主（未行药物激发试验或基因检测）、缺乏随访与心律失常事件结局，且急诊就诊人群存在选择偏倚，患病率外推至一般人群需谨慎。

title: Performance and Limitations of Multipolar Electrogram Mapping in Scar-Related Ventricular Tachycardia.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Multipolar electrogram is designed to improve near-field (NF) signal clarity by subtracting far-field (FF) components using adjacent electrodes.

OBJECTIVE: To assess the performance of multipolar electrogram mapping in identifying critical activation pathways and substrates in ventricular tachycardia (VT).

METHODS: Scar-related VT maps created using the CARTO™3 system and Optrell™ catheter were analyzed. Bipolar VT activation maps were created using wavefront algorithm (annotating unipolar maximum -dV/dt), while substrate maps employed late annotation mapping (LAM). Bipolar maps were converted into multipolar maps offline using the CARTOREPLAY TM module. Electrograms with both NF and FF components-including local abnormal ventricular activities (LAVA), late potentials (LP), and diastolic signals-were compared between bipolar and multipolar maps. Auto-annotation accuracy was evaluated.

RESULTS: A total of 3,636 electrograms from 53 maps (45 patients, age 64±9 years, 87% male, 57% ischemic) were analyzed. Multipolar signals showed higher NF/FF amplitude ratio than bipolar signals (1.50 [0.61-3.08] vs. 1.19 [0.52-2.60], p<0.0001). Multipolar activation mapping more accurately identified diastolic potentials than bipolar wavefront mapping (76% vs. 46%, p<0.0001). However, multipolar substrate mapping was less sensitive in detecting LAVA/LP than bipolar LAM (80% vs. 92%, p<0.0001). Of 30 maps with LPs, 87% had LPs missed by the multipolar algorithm but captured by LAM. Smaller NF / larger FF amplitudes and perimeter electrodes predicted multipolar annotation errors.

CONCLUSIONS: Multipolar activation mapping enhances diastolic potential detection but reduces sensitivity for VT substrate identification compared to bipolar LAM. These findings inform optimal electrogram annotation approaches for VT activation and substrate mapping.

AI.tldr: 在 45 例瘢痕相关室速患者中，多极电图（Optrell 导管）标测比双极标测更易识别舒张期电位（76% 对 46%），但检测 LAVA/晚电位敏感度更低（80% 对 92%），多极与双极标测各有优势，不能相互替代。
AI.motivation: 多极电图通过相邻电极相减来削弱远场成分，理论上可提高近场信号清晰度，但它在室速关键传导通路与基质识别中的实际表现尚缺乏系统验证，既往证据多来自小样本或单一标测模式，临床尚不清楚应在何种标测环节优先使用多极信号。
AI.method: 回顾性分析使用 CARTO™3 系统与 Optrell™ 导管创建的瘢痕相关室速标测图。双极室速激动图采用波前算法，标注单极最大 -dV/dt；基质图采用晚电位标注法（LAM）。双极图离线经 CARTOREPLAY™ 模块转换为多极图。比较含近场与远场成分的电图（LAVA、晚电位、舒张期信号）在双极与多极图中的表现，并评估自动标注准确性。共纳入 45 例患者、53 幅标测图、3,636 个电图；患者年龄 64±9 岁，男性占 87%，缺血性病因占 57%。
AI.result: 多极信号的近场与远场振幅比高于双极信号（1.50 [0.61–3.08] 对 1.19 [0.52–2.60]，P<0.0001）。多极激动标测识别舒张期电位的准确率高于双极波前标测（76% 对 46%，P<0.0001）；但多极基质标测检测 LAVA/晚电位的敏感度低于双极 LAM（80% 对 92%，P<0.0001）。在 30 幅存在晚电位的标测图中，87% 的晚电位被多极算法漏标，却能被 LAM 捕获。近场振幅较小、远场振幅较大以及周边电极（perimeter electrodes）可预测多极自动标注误差。
AI.conclusion: 多极激动标测可提高舒张期电位检出率、有助于明确室速关键通路，但会降低基质（LAVA/晚电位）识别敏感度，因此不宜完全取代双极 LAM。临床实践中宜按标测目的选择标注方式：激动标测优先多极信号，基质标测仍以双极 LAM 为主，并对近场低振幅、远场高振幅及周边电极区域进行人工复核。本研究为单中心、回顾性、离线转换分析，样本量有限，结论需前瞻性验证。

title: Feasibility and Acute Hemodynamic Outcomes of S3 Functional Mapping During Scar-Related Ventricular Tachycardia Ablation.
Multimodality Cardiovascular Imaging in the Evaluation of Cardiac Sarcoidosis.
summary: Cardiac sarcoidosis (CS) is a granulomatous disease associated with increased cardiovascular risk, including symptomatic high-grade atrioventricular block, ventricular arrhythmia, heart failure, and sudden cardiac death. Diagnosis can be challenging and requires a high index of suspicion. Although endomyocardial biopsy demonstrating noncaseating granulomas can diagnose CS with high specificity, sampling error leads to low sensitivity. CS is typically diagnosed using a combination of clinical criteria and advanced cardiac imaging, such as cardiac magnetic resonance and positron emission tomography, which can detect myocardial inflammation and fibrosis seen in CS. Recent advances in cardiac magnetic resonance and positron emission tomography have not only substantially improved the diagnosis of CS, but have also improved prognostic assessment, monitoring of treatment response, and guidance of other clinical decision-making, such as immunosuppressive and device therapy. Advanced cardiac imaging has been incorporated into recent international guidelines on inflammatory heart disease, and holds great promise to reshape contemporary clinical care for patients with CS.

AI.tldr: 本综述指出，心脏磁共振与正电子发射断层显像的多模态影像已成为心脏结节病诊断、预后评估、疗效监测及免疫抑制与器械治疗决策的核心工具，并已被纳入近期国际指南。

title: Seizure Like Activity During Permanent Pacemaker Implantation: A Case of Suspected Venous Air Embolism With Acute Hypoxia
summary: Venous air embolism is a rare complication of pacemaker implantation. A 78 year old man developed sudden generalized stiffness, seizure-like activity, and severe hypoxia (oxygen saturation 70%) during lead manipulation without hypotension or arrhythmia. Prompt recognition, high-flow oxygen, and temporary procedural interruption led to complete recovery without neurological sequelae.

AI.tldr: 一例 78 岁男性在永久起搏器植入术中操作导线时突发全身僵直、癫痫样活动及严重低氧（血氧饱和度 70%），疑诊静脉空气栓塞，经高流量吸氧并暂停操作后完全恢复，无神经系统后遗症。

title: Case Report: Double-click on the ventricle: ventricular safety pacing triggered by right atrial lead dislodgement in a patient after right atrial tumor resection.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial lead dislodgment is not uncommon after permanent pacemaker implantation, especially in patients with atrial anatomic abnormity. Unique electrocardiography manifestation might give clues for promptly diagnosis. In patients with reconstructed right atrium, optimal pacing strategies and lead stability remain challenging.

CASE PRESENTATION: A 44-year-old woman developed symptomatic sinus node dysfunction after right atrial tumor resection and reconstruction. A dual-chamber pacemaker was implanted, resulting in symptom resolution. At routine follow-up, electrocardiography showed ventricle was intermittently captured by one initial pacing artifact which was immediately followed by another pacing artifact at a fixed interval of 110-ms, consistent with ventricular safety pacing. Device interrogation revealed normal ventricular lead parameters but loss of atrial capture. Imaging confirmed atrial lead dislodgement into the right ventricle. The atrial lead was subsequently extracted and the device was reprogrammed to VVI mode. After 3 months follow-up, the patient remained asymptomatic and was with normal cardiac function.

CONCLUSION: This case highlights the importance of diagnostic role of electrocardiography to detect lead dislodgement. In patents with surgically altered right atrium, individualized pacing strategies, such as single-chamber ventricular pacing, may be appropriate. Novel atrial pacing lead with fix helix or leadless pacing might do some help to reduce the risk of dislodgement.

AI.tldr: 一例右心房肿瘤切除重建后植入双腔起搏器的患者，因心房导线脱入右心室出现心室安全起搏心电图，提示心电图可早期识别导线脱位。
AI.motivation: 永久起搏器植入后心房导线脱位并不少见，尤其在心房解剖结构异常或重建术后患者中；此类患者的最佳起搏策略与导线稳定性仍具挑战。心电图可能出现特殊表现，为及时诊断导线脱位提供线索。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。44岁女性，因右心房肿瘤切除及重建术后出现症状性窦房结功能障碍，植入双腔起搏器后症状缓解。 routine随访时行心电图检查，并行起搏器程控和影像学检查；随后拔除心房导线并将装置重新程控为VVI模式，随访3个月。摘要未报告正式研究终点及统计方法。
AI.result: 随访心电图显示心室被首个起搏信号间歇性夺获，紧接着在固定110 ms间期出现第二个起搏信号，符合心室安全起搏。起搏器程控显示心室导线参数正常，但心房夺获丧失；影像学证实心房导线脱位进入右心室。拔除心房导线并程控为VVI模式后，随访3个月患者无症状，心功能正常。
AI.conclusion: 本病例强调心电图对发现起搏导线脱位的诊断价值。对于外科手术改变右心房结构的患者，个体化起搏策略（如单腔心室起搏）可能更合适；采用固定螺旋心房起搏导线或无导线起搏可能有助于降低导线脱位风险。结论受限于单例病例报告，尚需更多证据验证。

title: Consensus-Recommended Follow-Up Mediates Cardiovascular Outcomes Disparities Between Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillator and Pacemaker Recipients.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Consensus-recommended follow-up after cardiac implantable electronic device (CIED) implantation improves outcomes, yet whether it mediates cardiovascular disparities between device types remains unknown.

METHODS: We prospectively studied 6806 patients undergoing CIED implantation across a multi-hospital system (2019-2023; median follow-up 3.5 years), categorized as implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD) (n = 2757) or permanent pacemaker (PPM) (n = 4049). Causal mediation analysis decomposed the effect of device type on major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) and device extraction into direct and follow-up mediated components, adjusting for demographics and comorbidities.

RESULTS: ICD recipients had significantly lower consensus-recommended follow-up rates than PPM recipients (65.3% vs. 79.2%; adjusted OR 0.46, 95% CI 0.40-0.52, p < 0.001) and substantially higher MACE risk (HR 1.89, 95% CI 1.66-2.25, p < 0.001), of which 53.5% was mediated by follow-up adherence. Device extraction rates were lower in ICD recipients (HR 0.30, 95% CI 0.24-0.38), with only 7.9% mediated by follow-up adherence.

CONCLUSIONS: More than half of the excess cardiovascular risk in ICD recipients was statistically mediated by suboptimal follow-up adherence-a potentially modifiable pathway. These findings identify follow-up adherence as a potentially important pathway and support further prospective investigation of strategies to improve monitoring and clinical outcomes in high-risk CIED populations.

AI.tldr: 在6806例CIED植入患者中，ICD患者共识推荐随访率低于PPM，其较高MACE风险的53.5%由随访依从性中介，提示随访依从性是潜在可干预路径。
AI.motivation: 共识推荐的CIED植入后随访可改善预后，但随访是否介导ICD与起搏器患者之间的心血管结局差异尚不清楚；既往证据未量化这一可干预路径，本研究旨在填补该缺口。
AI.method: 前瞻性研究纳入多医院系统2019—2023年植入CIED的6806例患者，中位随访3.5年，其中ICD 2757例、永久起搏器（PPM）4049例。采用因果中介分析，在校正人口学与合并症后，将器械类型对主要不良心血管事件（MACE）和器械拔除的影响分解为直接效应与随访依从性中介效应；随访依从性按共识推荐随访定义，摘要未报告MACE具体组成。
AI.result: ICD组共识推荐随访率显著低于PPM组（65.3% vs 79.2%；校正OR 0.46，95%CI 0.40-0.52，P<0.001）。ICD组MACE风险显著更高（HR 1.89，95%CI 1.66-2.25，P<0.001），其中53.5%由随访依从性中介。器械拔除率在ICD组更低（HR 0.30，95%CI 0.24-0.38），仅7.9%由随访依从性中介。
AI.conclusion: ICD患者超过一半的额外心血管风险在统计上由随访依从性不足中介，提示该路径可能可干预，并支持在高风险CIED人群中前瞻性评估改善监测与随访的策略。作为观察性中介分析，结果受残余混杂、中介模型假设及随访依从性测量方式限制，MACE定义摘要未报告，临床推广需谨慎。

title: Deletion of the sodium leak channel NALCN in dopamine neurons alters D2R-mediated signalling and psychostimulant responsiveness.
summary: Midbrain dopamine (DA)-neurons are slow pacemakers that continuously fire action potentials, maintaining basal extracellular DA levels in target regions. The sodium leak channel NALCN has been identified as a key contributor in the pacemaker control of these neurons. However, the consequences of a disrupted DA pacemaker activity remain largely unexplored. By generating mice lacking NALCN selectively in midbrain DA-neurons, we investigated the impact of this deletion on the activity of ventral tegmental area DA-neurons, D2R-mediated signalling, reactivity to cues predicting threat and psychostimulant responsiveness in both males and females. Selective deletion of NALCN in midbrain DA-neurons dampens their tonic activity, without reducing the basal extracellular DA levels in the nucleus accumbens. Mice with a loss of NALCN in DA-neurons exhibit no impairments of basal motor responses, unaltered reactivity to cues predicting threat and risk assessment, while the neurochemical and behavioural responsiveness to psychostimulant drugs are enhanced and presynaptic D2R-mediated signalling at DA terminals is altered. Together, our results emphasize the important role of NALCN conductance in controlling DA pacemaker activity, D2R-mediated signalling and in modulating motor responses to psychostimulants. KEY POINTS: The sodium leak channel NALCN is an important contributor to the spontaneous pacemaker activity in dopamine neurons, but the consequences of its loss in these neurons remain largely unknown. We investigated how selective deletion of NALCN in dopamine neurons affects neuronal activity, dopamine receptor signalling and behavioural responses in male and female mice. Loss of NALCN markedly reduced the spontaneous activity of dopamine neurons, yet basal motor function, reward-related responses and reactivity to threat-predicting cues remained largely preserved. In contrast, neurochemical and behavioural responsiveness to psychostimulant drugs are enhanced, probably through an altered presynaptic D2R-mediated signalling at DA terminals. NALCN emerges as a key regulator of dopamine neuron activity, with disrupted pacemaker firing selectively enhancing psychostimulant sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 在中脑多巴胺神经元中条件性敲除钠漏通道 NALCN 的小鼠模型显示：VTA 多巴胺神经元紧张性起搏放电减弱，但伏隔核基础胞外多巴胺水平不下降，基础运动与威胁线索反应保留，而对精神兴奋剂的神经化学与行为反应显著增强。
AI.motivation: 中脑多巴胺神经元是持续放电的慢起搏细胞，维持靶区基础胞外多巴胺水平；钠漏通道 NALCN 已被证实是这一起搏活动的关键贡献者。然而，既往研究多聚焦通道本身的电生理特性，对“起搏活动被破坏后会产生哪些神经化学与行为后果”这一问题仍基本空白，尤其是 D2 受体（D2R）介导的信号与精神兴奋剂反应性是否受影响尚不清楚。
AI.method: 动物实验研究。通过条件性基因策略，在中脑多巴胺神经元中选择性敲除 NALCN，构建敲除小鼠，并纳入雄性与雌性。观察指标包括：腹侧被盖区（VTA）多巴胺神经元的紧张性放电活动、伏隔核基础胞外多巴胺水平、多巴胺末梢突触前 D2R 介导的信号、基础运动功能、对威胁预测线索的反应性与风险评估行为，以及精神兴奋剂（精神刺激类药物）引起的神经化学与行为反应。样本量、对照组构成、终点定义细节及统计方法，摘要未报告。
AI.result: 摘要未报告样本量、效应量、95% 置信区间与 P 值，仅给出定性结论：敲除 NALCN 后 VTA 多巴胺神经元紧张性放电明显减弱，但伏隔核基础胞外多巴胺水平并未降低；基础运动反应无损害，对威胁预测线索的反应性与风险评估行为未见改变；与之相对，对精神兴奋剂的神经化学与行为反应性增强，多巴胺末梢突触前 D2R 介导的信号发生改变。作者推测该增强可能由突触前 D2R 信号改变所致。雌雄小鼠均纳入，但摘要未报告性别间差异。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提示 NALCN 电导是中脑多巴胺神经元起搏活动、D2R 信号及运动反应调节的关键节点：其缺失虽在基础状态下被代偿（基础多巴胺水平与基础行为保留），却选择性放大对精神兴奋剂的敏感性，为“起搏放电异常参与成瘾易感性”提供了机制线索。局限在于这是小鼠基础研究，样本量、统计细节与性别差异均未在摘要中给出，且属临床前证据；对以器械治疗和临床电生理为主的实践尚无直接影响，但为理解多巴胺能自主起搏机制及药物反应个体差异提供了参考。

title: Safety of bioelectrical impedance analysis in patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices: A systematic review.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Bioelectrical impedance analysis is widely used in clinical settings to assess body composition, contributes to the management of various health conditions. However, for patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices, such as pacemakers and implantable cardioverter-defibrillators, concerns about electromagnetic interference have led to longstanding recommendations against using bioelectrical impedance analysis. In this systematic review, we aimed to assess the available evidence regarding the safety of cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs) during bioelectrical impedance analysis procedures.

METHODS: Following PRISMA guidelines, we searched PubMed, IEEE Xplore, Embase, and CINAHL for studies reporting on bioelectrical impedance analysis safety in patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices. Inclusion criteria focused on human studies reporting CIED function outcomes during BIA measurements. Data on BIA frequencies, types of CIEDs and BIA, and observed electromagnetic interference effects were extracted. The quality and bias of the studies were assessed using the Oxford Levels of Evidence and ROBINS-I tools.

RESULTS: Out of 2003 records screened, 8 studies were included, encompassing 866 BIA measurements across frequencies ranging from 5 to 500 kHz. No studies reported electromagnetic interference or adverse events affecting CIED functionality.

CONCLUSION: No evidence of electromagnetic interference or adverse effects on CIED function was identified in the available studies evaluating BIA in patients with CIEDs. These findings support reconsideration of clinical recommendations that discourage BIA use in this population.

AI.tldr: 系统评价纳入8项研究、866次生物电阻抗分析测量，未发现电磁干扰或对心脏植入型电子器械功能的不良影响。
AI.motivation: 生物电阻抗分析广泛用于体成分评估，但起搏器、ICD等心脏植入型电子器械（CIED）患者长期被建议避免使用，担心电磁干扰影响器械功能；既往证据零散，缺乏系统汇总。
AI.method: 按PRISMA指南系统检索PubMed、IEEE Xplore、Embase和CINAHL，纳入报告CIED患者接受生物电阻抗分析时器械功能结局的人体研究，提取BIA频率、CIED与BIA类型及电磁干扰表现，并以牛津证据等级和ROBINS-I工具评估质量与偏倚。
AI.result: 共筛查2003条记录，最终纳入8项研究，涵盖866次BIA测量，频率范围5–500 kHz；所有研究均未报告电磁干扰事件，也未报告影响CIED功能的不良事件。摘要未报告各研究的偏倚风险评级及具体器械类型的分层结果。
AI.conclusion: 现有证据未显示BIA对CIED功能产生电磁干扰或不良影响，支持重新审视禁止该人群使用BIA的临床推荐；但纳入研究数量少、多为观察性设计，证据等级有限，仍需针对不同CIED类型与高频率BIA的前瞻性监测验证。

title: Device-Sparing Posteroseptal Trans-Tricuspid Lead Implantation After Tricuspid TEER: A Three-Case Device Rounds Report.
summary: Transvenous right ventricular lead implantation after tricuspid transcatheter edge-to-edge repair (T-TEER) may be challenging because of potential interaction with implanted repair devices, grasped leaflets, or the repaired coaptation zone. We describe three patients requiring transvenous pacemaker or implantable cardioverter-defibrillator implantation after T-TEER with TriClip or PASCAL systems. In each case, the posterior-most T-TEER device was used as a fluoroscopic landmark to guide lead passage inferior and posterior to the device toward an unobstructed posteroseptal residual orifice. Pacemaker leads were delivered using catheter-and-wire crossing followed by advancement of a long slittable sheath, whereas the defibrillator lead required direct shaping and fluoroscopic manipulation because of sheathlead incompatibility. Implantation was successful in all three patients. During 612 months of follow-up, tricuspid regurgitation remained mild or trace, mean transtricuspid gradients ranged from 1.8 to 2.1 mmHg, and no echocardiographic leadleaflet or leaddevice interaction or lead-related complications were observed. This fluoroscopy-guided, device-sparing strategy may represent a practical option when transvenous right ventricular lead implantation is clinically necessary after T-TEER.

AI.tldr: 三例T-TEER后需起搏器或ICD的患者，以最靠后T-TEER器械为透视标志、经后间隔残余瓣口送入右室导线，均成功且随访无导线-瓣叶/器械交互。
AI.motivation: 三尖瓣经导管缘对缘修复（T-TEER）后如需经静脉植入右心室导线，导线可能与植入器械、被夹合瓣叶或修复后对合区发生交互，导致操作困难；既往缺乏明确、可复制的导线植入策略。
AI.method: 三例病例系列，患者均在T-TEER（TriClip或PASCAL系统）后需植入经静脉起搏器或ICD。操作以最靠后的T-TEER器械作为透视标志，引导导线从器械下方、后方通过，进入无遮挡的后间隔残余瓣口；起搏导线采用导管-导丝跨越后送入长可撕鞘，除颤导线因鞘-导线不兼容需直接塑形并在透视下操作。观察植入成功率、三尖瓣反流程度、平均跨三尖瓣压差及导线-瓣叶/器械交互和导线相关并发症；摘要未报告统计方法。
AI.result: 三例均植入成功。随访6～12个月（原文排版为“612 months”），三尖瓣反流保持轻度或微量，平均跨三尖瓣压差1.8～2.1 mmHg；超声心动图未见导线-瓣叶或导线-器械交互，亦无导线相关并发症。摘要未报告P值或95%CI。
AI.conclusion: 该透视引导、避让器械的后间隔经三尖瓣右室导线植入策略在T-TEER后临床必须经静脉植入时具有可操作性。但证据仅来自三例病例报告，缺乏对照和长期随访，技术依赖操作经验，尚需更大样本验证其安全性和有效性。

title: Sex-related phenotypic differences in myotonic dystrophy types 1 and 2: a nationwide registry study from Serbia
summary: Background Myotonic dystrophies (DM) are autosomal dominant, multisystem disorders with variable clinical expressions. DM1 and DM2 share overlapping features, such as myotonia and muscle weakness, but differ in age at onset, severity, progression and multisystem features. Emerging evidence suggests that biological sex influences disease manifestations, progression, and outcomes.Objective To assess sex-specific differences among patients with genetically confirmed DM1 and DM2.Patients and methods This cross-sectional study included 587 adult patients (391 DM1, 196 DM2) from the Serbian Registry for Myotonic Dystrophies. Comprehensive assessments included neuromuscular examination, electrophysiological testing, systemic evaluation (cardiac, respiratory, endocrine, skeletal, and ophthalmologic), laboratory analysis, and functional status. Muscle strength was measured using a modified Medical Research Council score. Statistical analyses compared male and female patients within each DM type. Given the exploratory nature of the study, no adjustment for multiple comparisons was applied.Results In DM1, the male-to-female ratio was 1.1:1. Males exhibited more severe neuromuscular involvement, including less strength in distal upper limb and proximal lower limb, longer myotonia duration, higher prevalence of dysarthria, dysphagia, polyneuropathy, skeletal deformities, baldness, and infertility, as well as more common impairment on ECG. In DM2, females predominated (ratio 1.5:1) and showed more pronounced weakness in proximal lower limb, reduced respiratory capacity, and more common cataracts. DM2 males had longer myotonia, higher prevalence of polyneuropathy, baldness, infertility, hyperglycemia, and more frequent pacemaker implantation.Conclusions Sex is associated with distinct phenotypic profiles in DM1 and DM2. Greater neuromuscular burden was seen in DM1 males and DM2 females. On the other hand, male patients generally exhibit more cardiologic and endocrinological/metabolic burden in both DM1 and DM2. Incorporating sex as a variable in clinical evaluation, risk stratification, and therapeutic planning may be essential for personalized management of DM patients in future.

AI.tldr: 塞尔维亚注册研究显示，强直性肌营养不良1型男性与2型女性神经肌肉负担更重，而两型男性心脏及代谢/内分泌负担更高。
AI.motivation: DM1与DM2为常染色体显性多系统疾病，临床表型异质；既往证据提示生物性别可能影响发病、进展和结局，但缺乏全国注册队列中按DM类型分层的性别差异数据。
AI.method: 横断面研究，纳入塞尔维亚强直性肌营养不良注册队列587例成人（DM1 391例、DM2 196例），均经基因确诊；完成神经肌肉查体、电生理检查、心脏/呼吸/内分泌/骨骼/眼科系统评估、实验室检查及功能状态评估，肌力采用改良MRC评分；在每个DM类型内比较男女，探索性分析未校正多重比较。摘要未报告具体终点定义及统计方法细节。
AI.result: DM1男女比1.1:1，男性远端上肢和近端下肢肌力更差、肌强直持续时间更长，构音障碍、吞咽困难、多发性神经病、骨骼畸形、秃发和不育更常见，心电图异常更常见。DM2女性占优（女男比1.5:1），近端下肢无力、呼吸能力下降和白内障更常见；DM2男性肌强直更长，多发性神经病、秃发、不育、高血糖及起搏器植入更常见。摘要未报告效应量、95%CI及P值。
AI.conclusion: 性别与DM1/DM2不同表型相关：DM1男性及DM2女性神经肌肉负担更重，男性在两型中心脏及内分泌/代谢负担更高；提示临床评估、风险分层和治疗规划应纳入性别变量。但研究为横断面探索性分析、未校正多重比较且缺乏效应量，需纵向研究验证。

title: Contemporary use of oesophageal temperature probes during left atrial ablation: results from an EHRA Scientific Initiatives Committee survey.
Tafamidis: is it truly a game changer for transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy?
summary: Transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis (ATTR-CM) is an increasingly recognized condition caused by the misfolding of transthyretin (TTR) protein, leading to amyloid deposits in various tissues and organs. In 2019, tafamidis was the first FDA-approved disease-modifying therapy to address an unmet need for patients with ATTR-CM, stabilizing TTR proteins and preventing dissociation. Tafamidis has been shown to reduce all-cause mortality and slow decline in functional capacity and quality of life and is generally considered a safe treatment because of its minimal major drug interactions. However, tafamidis has several well-recognized limitations, including high cost, reduced effectiveness in advanced disease stages, limited ability to address established amyloid burden, and limited evidence for advanced polyneuropathy. As new therapies and advancements emerge, further research is needed to compare their relative effectiveness. In this review, we explore the development of tafamidis, pivotal clinical trial results, clinical applications, safety considerations, and future therapeutic directions for ATTR-CM.

AI.tldr: 综述指出，tafamidis 作为首个获 FDA 批准用于转甲状腺素蛋白心肌淀粉样变（ATTR-CM）的疾病修饰治疗，可降低全因死亡并延缓功能与生活质量恶化，但受高费用、晚期疗效有限等制约，尚难称为彻底的“游戏规则改变者”。
AI.motivation: ATTR-CM 由转甲状腺素蛋白（TTR）错误折叠并在多组织器官沉积所致，既往长期缺乏能改变疾病进程的药物治疗，临床需求未被满足。2019 年 tafamidis 成为首个获 FDA 批准用于该病的疾病修饰药物，但它在真实临床中的疗效边界、安全性与局限性仍需系统梳理。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述，非原始研究：围绕 tafamidis 的研发历程、关键临床试验结果、临床应用定位、安全性考量，以及 ATTR-CM 未来治疗方向进行归纳评述。摘要未报告所纳入研究的样本量、终点定义具体细节及统计方法。
AI.result: 摘要未报告具体的效应量、95%CI 与 P 值。综述归纳的要点是：tafamidis 通过稳定 TTR 四聚体、阻止其解离而发挥作用，已被证实可降低全因死亡率，并延缓功能储备与生活质量的下降；该药主要药物相互作用少，总体安全性良好。其明确局限包括：治疗费用高昂、在疾病晚期阶段疗效减弱、对已形成的淀粉样蛋白负荷清除能力有限，以及在晚期多发性神经病中证据不足。
AI.conclusion: tafamidis 是 ATTR-CM 治疗史上的里程碑，确立了疾病修饰治疗的可行性，但并非万能方案，早期识别与早期干预是获益前提。随着新药不断涌现，亟需开展不同疗法之间的相对疗效比较研究。对电生理实践而言，ATTR-CM 患者常合并心房颤动与传导系统受累，需评估起搏与 ICD 指征，应在心肌淀粉样变早期完成筛查与转诊。局限性：本文为叙述性综述，未采用系统评价方法，缺乏定量合并与头对头比较证据。
